items.text: On phones, press and hold a card to see its details directly; on computers, right-click it
Tapping a card opens a menu beside it listing what you can do with that card; "Details" shows it enlarged
On wide screens, a card detail panel on the right shows a card's effect and Power breakdown when you select or hover over it
Fixed the Discard Pile window not closing: you can now close it by tapping outside, pressing Esc, or "Close"
You can forfeit a game: press "Forfeit" at the top and confirm, and your opponent wins
When your opponent stops responding (repeated timeouts or disconnected), you are told and can end the game or keep waiting
When neither player responds, the room is closed and the table is freed
Fixed refreshing turning you into your opponent when both players use tabs of the same browser
Fixed being sent home on an unstable connection with no way back to the game while the table kept your name; failed connections now retry automatically
Fixed the connection dropping after the game was idle for a while

releases.title: LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell

images.alt: LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell
Zeno and the Most Powerful Mamodo

items.text: Season 3 cards are here. Products: "LEVEL:3 Supreme Power of the Golden Spell", "Zatch Bell and His Friends", "Zeno and the Most Powerful Mamodo", "LIMITED EDITION I", "Special Box", "Spell Book File Vol. 2", "Spell Book Expansion Sheet LEVEL:2"
New Tables mode: take a seat to play other players, no room code needed
Choose a season to play the format of a different period; the Rules page shows which cards each season allows
Click the logo at any time to go home, and return to a game in progress from the home page
Tournament rules: the first player gets no MP from page turns on turn 1, and only one copy of each PR card number is allowed
Coin flip sub-phase: a clear order in which both players take turns using effects that change a coin result
A result screen after each game, with a rematch option for NPC games

Defined how "X's spell" (such as "Zatch Bell's spell" or "that MAMODO's spell") is judged: a spell whose MAMODO is X, or a spell used by X, both count. For example, if the opponent uses E-024 Professor Dartagnan to lock spells for your Zatch Bell or M-029 Zeno, you cannot have M-029 Zeno use a Zatch Bell spell either way
Clearer UI: the deck builder's filter options now have icons
Clearer UI: the attacking and defending cards appear on the center battle stage, so it is clear when a battle is on
Clearer UI: the protect choice shows the damage about to be taken
Clearer UI: see the estimated total Power when choosing a spell
Clearer UI: buttons you cannot press now tell you why
Clearer UI: on the last page of your Spell Book you are warned that ending the turn loses the game
Clearer UI: when an effect triggers, the card it comes from is spotlighted
Clearer UI: Cost and Power change color when an effect changes them
Clearer UI: when E-018 Folgore's Dance has no effect because its condition is not met, the log says why
Smarter NPC: after interrupting your attack, the NPC remembers the attack when deciding. For example, after interrupting with E-024 Professor Dartagnan it can choose the attacking MAMODO to lock
Wording: "attack without a spell" is now called "MAMODO-effect attack"
Translations: several LEVEL:1 / 2 cards' Chinese and English texts did not match the Japanese originals
Fixed MAMODO-effect attacks having no use limit, and M-026 Maruss being unable to negate them
Fixed "while this card is on the field" effects ignoring "cannot use effects"
Fixed the previous game's log remaining in a new room
Fixed M-019 Kanchome re-flipping both coins of E-005 Suzy's Lucky Fruit (it should re-flip only one)
Fixed M-019 Kanchome's option showing a cost of 2 MP (it costs 0)
Fixed the action buttons jumping around
Fixed the page count possibly showing more than 32 when the Spell Book runs out
Turn dial: the action bar shows the turn player and the acting player on a dial; after one pass it tilts 45° to warn that one more pass ends the turn
Pass and Accept buttons now explain what they do (take no more actions this turn / take no action on opponent's turn / use no BATTLE effect; or take a No-BATTLE action instead of accepting)
Power showdown: both mamodo and their spells face off in the center, with a clear "Attack succeeds" or "Defense holds"
Damage and protection effects: energy flies to the damaged Spell Book or mamodo, a protecting mamodo steps in front to take it, and discarded cards fly to the Discard Pile
Browse your Spell Book on the board with the arrow buttons; in the Start Phase, browse to the page you want and the matching flip button appears
Choose which mamodo uses a spell and which mamodo a partner attaches to, right on the board
When choosing a card, the Spell Book or Discard Pile opens automatically and says what to choose
View the cards stacked under a stacked mamodo
Sound effects in games
The home page shows how many people are playing
Maintenance notices appear at the top of the screen before maintenance
Deck builder: cards show Intermediate / Superior and the card number, with a details view; the mamodo filter has "None" to find command spells
The site is now Gash Card Battle Online, with a new title and icon
Chinese terms unified; local test mode is now called "Free Investigation"
Mamodo keep their positions on the board; when the left one leaves, the others no longer shift left
Deck builder: remove a card with the Remove button, so double-clicking no longer deletes by accident
Phone layout adjustments for the action log and Spell Book grid

Viewing a Spell Book: M-011, E-016 and E-017 can be used even if the opponent's book has no target; you see the whole book, and the opponent acts only after you finish viewing. M-018 and E-014 now show you the opponent's open pages first
Choosing effects in any order: E-021 lets you use one or both effects in the order you choose
Borrowed partner effects: an effect borrowed with E-010 stays usable after that partner leaves play
Usable without a target: P-003, P-004 and P-006 can be used any time; they just have no effect if their target isn't there
Not usable without a target: S-043 and S-048 can't be used (and cost no MP) when there is no mamodo to choose; S-043's split places the two mamodo one at a time
Timing: P-001 can only be used on your own turn; M-012 can't reflip while restricted by E-024 / E-025
Command spells: S-026 and other command spells let you choose which mamodo uses them, and the log shows them as spells
A mamodo stacked onto an injured one stays injured
Non-BATTLE spells with the same name on different pages can each be used once
Card images load faster
